purpose: Runtime data policy for every XVS renderer / data tool. Code MUST load this file and enforce it: the browser may only talk to the local server; the local tile/data proxy may only fetch upstream URLs that match an 'upstream_allowed' entry. Any other request is aborted, logged to data_violations.jsonl, and makes the run FAIL. Tooling installs (pip, npm, Playwright browser download) are outside this policy.

upstream_allowed.tiling: EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100), 256x256, LODs 0-23 advertised; service description says 'visible to the 1:9,028 zoom scale' (= level 16). Deepest level with real detail must be measured in WP-01 G0.
upstream_allowed.license: U.S. Public Domain. USGS policy: 'USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain.'
upstream_allowed.coverage_rule: Use only for scenes inside the conterminous US (CONUS). Alaska and Hawaii need Director approval: the USGS lists commercially licensed orthoimagery there (USGS FAQ 'Are USGS topographic maps copyrighted?'). WP-01 scenes (KSFO) are inside CONUS.
upstream_allowed.attribution: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery
upstream_allowed.service_copyright_text: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery. Data refreshed June, 2024.v1.2
upstream_allowed.etiquette: max 4 concurrent upstream requests, User-Agent 'OpenXVS-research/0.1', exponential back-off on HTTP 429/5xx, never re-download a cached tile
upstream_allowed.verified: 2026-09-22 by Director (service JSON + USGS copyright policy page)

upstream_allowed.notes: Heights are NAVD88 orthometric metres. Convert to WGS84 ellipsoidal heights (h = H + N) before Cesium. Not used before WP-01b.

enforcement_scope: Enforced on (1) every page/worker request seen by Playwright routing (abort + log + FAIL if host not in browser_allowed_hosts) and (2) every upstream request made by the local proxy (must match upstream_allowed). Browser-internal background traffic (component updater etc.) is out of scope; keep it minimal by using Playwright's bundled Chromium with its default flags (do not use channel='chrome' unless the Director approves).
